This horse retexture was inspired by both avalitor's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/261/]Redesigned Horse Running Animation[/url] and Kitana Coldfire's [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/bigger-draft-horse-model-clydesdale-skin.112941/]Bigger Draft Horse Model[/url]. All the horse colors were inspired by real horses.
